headline: Pentagon chief announces military cooperation agreement with Venezuela
summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced a military agreement after an unannounced visit to Caracas. He is the highest-ranking US official to visit since US forces deposed Nicolás Maduro.
why: Venezuela holds some of the world's largest proven oil reserves, so political shifts there affect expectations for global crude supply.
original_headline: Jefe del Pentágono anuncia acuerdo de cooperación militar con Venezuela
